René is a dignified older silver-haired man with small rectangular glasses and gray moustache, blue suit and headset. row1 left: both watching rink below frame, gentle neutral closed mouths; right: same, modest speaking A mouths.
row2 left: same with rounded speaking mouths; right: same with both eyes gently CLOSED for a short blink.
